experiment_data.hypothesis: Epoch-matched control: training with uniform weighting on filtered data (q>0.5 removed) for exactly 2533 steps (matching content-level 1 epoch of the contaminated data). If PPL is comparable to the full 6103-step D&R run, the D&R benefit comes from data quality not extra training; if PPL is worse, the extra training contributes meaningfully.
experiment_data.notes: Content-level 1 epoch: 153K samples × ~540 avg tokens = ~83M tokens → max_steps=2533. NOT Trainer epoch (9607 steps/315M tokens).
